jobs.title: Business Solutions Specialist - PDEGO
jobs.why: Live employer posting emphasizes stakeholder discovery, requirements and testing sessions, no-code workflows, integration specs, data migration, training and documentation. October BA résumé documents Monday.com, Dynamics 365, Power Automate, data mapping and end-user training.
jobs.gap: Requests 2–5 years in enterprise business/systems analysis and hands-on low-code administration with security/governance; formal BA tenure is about one year. Airtable is preferred, not demonstrated.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
jobs.why: Live employer application and job description cover stakeholder workshops, current/future-state process maps, requirements, data migration mapping, UAT scripts, defect tracking, SOPs and user training; all align with documented CRM integration and process-improvement projects.
jobs.gap: Employer desires construction estimating, certified payroll, job-cost workflows, ERP platforms such as Viewpoint/Procore/HCSS and Power BI/Crystal Reports; these are not established on the October résumé. No fixed experience minimum is listed.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.why: Employer-managed live Wellfound listing seeks business requirements, process analysis, user stories, Agile coordination, UAT, stakeholder communication and digital-transformation projects, matching documented CRM implementation and testing experience.
jobs.gap: Requires 3+ years in business/systems/product analysis or related work, BA/IS/CS or related bachelor's degree, formal BRDs/FRDs and strong Agile/SDLC; October résumé has about one year in a formal BA role and a communications degree. SQL and Power BI are preferred, not claimed.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.why: Employer's current Wellfound listing corroborates Ashby job: client discovery, workflow diagrams, functional specs, UAT, pilot training and post-launch issue support. These map closely to documented process mapping, integration, testing and user-training experience.
jobs.gap: Requires 3+ years in BA/financial analyst/computer science roles and Agile product-lifecycle experience; formal BA tenure is shorter. Ashby page requires JavaScript and its submission form could not be tested.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY — hybrid/regular in-office presence
jobs.why: Live employer requisition posted Oct 5 covers requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, production troubleshooting, UAT, defect resolution, documentation and change management; October résumé evidences related CRM, QA and Jira work.
jobs.gap: Requires 3–5 years supporting IT systems plus a technical degree or equivalent experience; formal systems-analysis tenure is shorter and degree is in communications. An offer below $100K is possible.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - REMOTE
jobs.why: Live employer Greenhouse application (expires Dec 31, 2026) focuses on Excel reporting, CRM data hygiene, field mapping, dashboard governance and workflow automation; October résumé supports Power Query/GraphQL, JSON, record matching and process improvement.
